pages.title: Settings
pages.purpose: The one Settings hub (root tab 4 of the shell, also pushed by Ctrl/Cmd+,): a search field, then five groups of at most five rows (target-ia §1.3, slice-P3.10): the server under its own name (This server, Saved servers, On this phone), Agent (Model, Providers and accounts, Tools, AI Team), Conversations (Always allowed actions, Show reasoning, Show timestamps and usage, Default shell, Voice), This app (Notifications, Keep running, Appearance, Privacy and data, Usage) and an unlabelled Help panel (Setup guide, Report a problem, Available on this server, About). Row titles, keywords, gates and tap actions come from the app-wide search index (lib/ui/search/search_index.dart); the hub decides order, the live values and the two switches. Rows the connected server cannot serve are absent and each group says how many in one muted line with a Why (KitGroupNote) that opens Available on this server. Typing also lists what sits inside second-level screens ('Inside settings') and places outside Settings ('Go to').

pages.title: Choose a model
pages.purpose: The one model sheet (slice-P3.3): every door opens it through showModelPicker (composer model chip, '/model', a chat error's Choose model, Settings › Model and search; the catalog screen is gone). Settings opens it for new conversations (classic scope, promoted to newSessions on a server that owns selection); the chat opens it for this conversation (session scope, subtitle 'Applies to this conversation's next turns.'). Body: notices, a 'Reload providers' row when signed-in providers are not loaded, search with its filter menu, All/Favorites/Recent, the models (the chosen one checked, its details under it).
